claims.assertion: Mari Swa says Alcyone Council and Urmah members formed a cooperation treaty for mutual protection, trade, and technology.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says Antaria was also considering joining.

claims.assertion: Mari reports that Alfratean representatives challenged the treaty at a council meeting, which ended after King Ruhr ordered them to leave.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She describes the representatives as Federation agents.

review_flags: This is an unverified account of alleged extraterrestrial diplomacy and Federation interference.
coverage_gaps: The video also discusses alleged spiritual entities and Federation permissiveness toward them.
